lessons.trigger_condition: A verified-feedback autonomous cycle is ready to execute a new bounded action but prior evidence, meta feedback, capability state, or post-action trial state may fail to persist, making a retry ambiguous
lessons.prevention_rule: settle prior verified evidence before any new action; require durable skill and capability state; journal the action before and after execution; never auto-retry ambiguous execution; commit the pending causal trial before marking the cycle committed; export only a sanitized information-exchange summary; keep neural ranking advisory and market adaptation operational-only
validation_required: main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v376.py with skill, capability, and meta flags enabled
prior verified outcome or meta persistence failures block new execution
corrupt capability state blocks new execution without overwrite
autonomous execution requires skill and capability persistence
incomplete journal state blocks automatic retry
new action is journaled before execution and pending trial state is durable before journal committed
exchange capsule contains only sanitized operational summary
market direction, facts, prices, and grades are never invented or auto-promoted
source generation or rewrite, arbitrary command, direct-main, and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: autonomous evolution may adapt verified operational policy and advisory neural ranking, but it must fail closed across evidence and state persistence and may not turn uncertain execution into an automatic retry or unrestricted source self-modification
